title: ZhengSZ's Wonderland
description: This is a collection of classical Chinese architecture works originally created by ZhengSZ.
body:
[1.21.x]ZhengSZ的奇境 版本1.0.0 “青兰道场”

[1.21.x]ZhengSZ's Wonderland v1.0.0 "BlueOrchid"

这个作品共有1个结构、14座建筑和2种地牢。

This work consists of 1 structure, 14 buildings and 2 types of dungeons.

你可以输入以下指令快速查询这个结构的坐标。

You can enter the following instructions to quickly query the coordinates of this structure.


**/locate structure zhengsz:blue_orchid**


这是以我为名的自定义结构数据包。我想把我的作品制作成可以游玩和冒险的数据包。

This is a custom structure datapack named after me. I wanna turn my work into a datapack where people can play and go on adventures.

第一个版本，也就是这个数据包的第一个结构以“青兰”为名。

The first version, that is, the first structure of this data package is named "Blue Orchid".

这个结构以中国的道教建筑群为灵感，并以原版游戏中的兰花为主题。

This structure is inspired by the Taoist architectural complexes in China and is themed around the orchids in the original game.

我设计了一个风格古朴，规模收敛的古典中式建筑群。

I designed a classical Chinese architectural complex with a simple and elegant style and a compact scale.

同时我还以中国的古墓为灵感，设计了他的地下地牢，也就是这个数据包的冒险要素。

At the same time, I drew inspiration from Chinese ancient tombs and designed its underground dungeon, which is the adventure element of this data package.

未来我会添加更多结构和地牢，还请多多关注。

In the future, I will add more structures and dungeons. Please subscribe if you like.

希望你玩得愉快！

Hope you have a good time!
